blurb: Gray Monk Estate Winery has been pioneering cool-climate winemaking since 1972. They offer a range of wine tasting experiences to immerse guests in the flavours, aromas, and stories of their wines. The winery is rooted in tradition and innovation, with a legacy of introducing cool-climate varietals to BC.
